prompt: A cinematic film still captures a tense moment in a sterile hospital corridor. On the far left, an elderly woman in a wool coat sits on a plastic chair, clutching a worn leather purse. Next to her stands a young nurse in blue scrubs, pointing at a clipboard held by a tired doctor in a grey suit. The doctor looks at the clipboard with furrowed brows while holding a silver pen. In the center foreground, a golden retriever lies on the linoleum floor, resting its head on a pair of discarded sneakers. A child in a yellow raincoat kneels beside the dog, gently stroking its fur. Behind them, a tall man in a black trench coat leans against the wall, watching the scene with crossed arms. To his right, a woman in a floral dress holds a bouquet of wilted roses, looking at the elderly woman. Near the reception desk on the right, a security guard in a uniform stands with hands on hips, talking to a delivery person in an orange vest. The delivery person hands a small cardboard box to a receptionist in a white blouse. Above them, a flickering fluorescent light hangs from the ceiling, casting long shadows. A potted fern sits on the counter next to a ringing telephone. In the background, a janitor pushes a mop bucket past a closed elevator door. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. There is no sunlight streaming through windows.
